evidence_items.locator: Section 4, Evaluation of LLMs on the Blocksworld domain
evidence_items.explanation: The study supports the planning-reliability concern and reports severe deterioration after renaming domain elements. It also finds benefits from external verification; neither result directly measures the absence of stable internal world models.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1.1, discussion of probing and intervention
evidence_items.explanation: The researchers identify a board-state representation and intervene on it to change predictions. This challenges a blanket architectural absence claim, but the synthetic Othello model does not establish stable general world models in contemporary conversational LLMs.

The framework uses an LLM for world-state prediction alongside tree search and rewards, improving planning performance. This is relevant to the proposed mechanism, but the combined intervention does not isolate world-model stability as the cause.

unresolved_gaps: No cited study isolates absent or unstable world representations as the cause of both planning and reasoning unreliability across representative 2023 LLMs.
The planning tests do not establish performance across all forms of reasoning.
The synthetic representation study has a narrower scope than the claim.
